sloka: ततः प्रचक्रमे वक्तुम् वचनम् स महामुनिः ।भर्द्वाजो महातेजा रामम् सत्यपराक्रमम् ॥२-५५-३॥
transliteration: tataḥ pracakrame vaktum vacanam sa mahāmuniḥ ।bhardvājo mahātejā rāmam satyaparākramam ॥2-55-3॥

translations.english: Then that great effulgent sage Bharadwaja began to speak to Rama whose strength was truth.
